title: Bronze Account: Getting interest payments
summary: Explains how the Bronze Account earns interest: interest compounds daily and is credited monthly as a single net interest transaction line item. It also covers how the period APY (e.g., 2.0%) appears on disclosures and lists credit-card bonus APYs (+0.1% Bronze Rewards, +0.25% Gold Rewards, +0.2% Green Rewards, +0.3% Crypto-Cash Back; others +0%).
